name: PostalForm
description: PostalForm helps AI agents create reviewable physical-mail drafts and, when explicitly authorized, pay for print-and-mail orders through MCP, hosted checkout, MPP, or x402.

extensions.description: x402 machine-payment discovery for PostalForm machine orders.
UCP shopping profile for PostalForm checkout and commerce discovery.

skills.name: Connect an agent to PostalForm MCP
skills.description: Return the remote MCP endpoint, skill file, developer docs, and safe approval guidance for agents that need PostalForm print-and-mail tools.
examples: How should my agent connect to PostalForm?
What endpoint should a coding agent use to mail a PDF with PostalForm?

skills.name: Plan a reviewable physical-mail draft
skills.description: Explain the PostalForm draft path for PDFs, letters, supported workflow forms, and bulk mailing campaigns so a human can review the preview, addresses, price, and checkout before payment.
examples: Create a reviewable draft for mailing this PDF.
Which PostalForm MCP tool should I use for a plain letter?

skills.name: Plan an authorized machine-paid mail order
skills.description: Explain when to use PostalForm x402 or MPP payment flows, quote and validate endpoints, idempotency requirements, and owner-approval guardrails before creating paid physical mail.
examples: How can an autonomous agent quote and pay for a PostalForm order?
Which endpoint validates a machine-paid mail order before payment?
